tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

question.text: Which of the following reduction reaction CANNOT be carried out with coke?

solution.text: Reduction of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>Al</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>→</mo><mi>Al</mi></math> is carried out by electrolytic reduction of its fused salts. <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>ZnO</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><msub><mi>Fe</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>Cu</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math> can be reduced by carbon.
